_comment: Operator lineup. Commission terms are deliberately NOT stored here - this repo is public. 'offer' and 'rating' are empty until real values are supplied; the generator renders a neutral CTA rather than inventing bonus terms.

operators.name: Spinjo
pros: Fast crypto cashouts in our checks
cons: NZ$7.50 max bet while a bonus is active
operators.body: Spinjo tops our table for New Zealand players. It holds balances in NZD, runs a four-deposit welcome package and cleared crypto withdrawals fastest of the sites we checked, with a 40× wagering requirement that sits at the fair end of the market.

operators.name: Lucky Circus
cons: Headline figure is spread across several deposits
operators.body: Lucky Circus runs the largest headline welcome offer on our list — up to NZ$8,000 plus 450 free spins. The trade-off is a 45× wagering requirement, the highest of our group, so the real value depends on how much you plan to play through.

operators.name: Bet&Play
cons: General bonus terms default to 45× unless an offer states otherwise
NZ$10 max bet counts toward wagering
operators.body: Bet&Play pairs a large casino with a full sportsbook. The casino welcome is 125% up to NZ$1,500 + 250 free spins on the first deposit at 40× wagering, followed by three reload-coded deposits.

operators.name: Lucky7even
cons: Unclaimed free spins expire in 14 days
operators.body: Lucky7even asks only NZ$20 to trigger its four-part welcome package (up to ~NZ$2,000 + 200 free spins). Wagering is a standard 40× and the site keeps balances in NZD.

operators.name: Lucky Vibe
pros: One login for casino, live and sports
cons: NZ$7.50 max bet during bonus play
operators.body: Lucky Vibe is the only site on our list covering pokies, live dealer and a sportsbook on one account. The casino welcome is 100% up to NZ$1,000 + 100 free spins at 40× wagering; the sportsbook adds two free-bet bonuses.

operators.name: Rooster Bet
operators.note: Casino=TRUE with no casino link; falls back to the betting link, matching the shared-link pattern used by Lucky Vibe, Fortune Play, Roby and others.

operators.name: MadCasino
operators.note: Interim link supplied 2026-08-31; note utm_campaign=woodward while Kingdom/Smash/Rivo use chrischem.

operators.name: Roby Casino
pros: NZ$200 max bet during bonus play
cons: NZ$40 minimum deposit is higher than most
Max win from the bonus capped at 10×
operators.body: Roby Casino runs the lowest wagering requirement on our list — 35× on deposit plus bonus — and a NZ$200 max bet while a bonus is active, which suits larger stakes. The welcome package reaches 250% up to NZ$5,000 + 250 free spins over three deposits.

operators.name: Spino
operators.note: Sports=TRUE with no betting link; falls back to the casino link, same shared-link pattern.
pros: No wagering — cashback is real money
cons: Cashback only pays on net losses
No free spins or match bonus
operators.body: Spino is a crypto-only casino that skips deposit-match bonuses entirely: new players get 20% cashback on net losses up to 2,000 USDT, paid straight to the real balance with nothing to wager through. It advertises no documents for sign-up, deposits or withdrawals.

operators.name: Ivibet Casino
pros: Casino, sports and crypto on one account
Instant bonus round on the first deposit
cons: First-deposit casino cap is only NZ$150
operators.body: Ivibet keeps its welcome simple: a flat 100% first-deposit match (up to NZ$150 + 120 free spins for casino) with no promo code. Minimum deposit is NZ$35 and wagering is 40×.

operators.name: Ivibet Sportsbook
pros: Casino, sports and crypto on one account
Instant bonus round on the first deposit
cons: First-deposit casino cap is only NZ$150
operators.body: Ivibet keeps its welcome simple: a flat 100% first-deposit match (up to NZ$150 + 120 free spins for casino) with no promo code. Minimum deposit is NZ$35 and wagering is 40×.

operators.name: Hellspin
pros: Instant bonus round on the first deposit
operators.body: Hellspin runs a 100% first-deposit match up to NZ$300 + 100 free spins, with a flat 40× wagering requirement applied across every bonus type. Minimum deposit is NZ$35.

operators.name: Slotsgem
pros: Free spins across the first two deposits
cons: Top tier needs a NZ$450 deposit
Bonus must be wagered within 7 days
operators.body: SlotsGem scales its first-deposit bonus to your stake — 100% up to NZ$150 for a small deposit, rising to 120% up to NZ$1,200 + 125 free spins for NZ$450 or more. Wagering is 40× and the minimum deposit is NZ$30.
